notes:
What's new in Eliya Notes 1.1:
• Pasted text now matches the style you're writing in (Edit → Paste with Original Formatting keeps the old look)
• Make AI notes from Keynote files (and old .ppt) too
• New plain color themes: Pink, Purple, Blue, Green, Teal, Orange, Red, Yellow, Lavender, Gray, Midnight Blue, Black
• Import your OneNote notes (File → Import from OneNote…)
• Automatic updates
